description: Adds charts of a Tableau view or Power BI page the report holds as a picture, each as a datasheet of its own: its data, to read with getReportDatasheetData or queryReportData and draw on a slide, its picture, or both. Pass the picture's datasheet id, from addReportDatasheets or listReportDatasheets, and the refs of the charts getReportDatasheet lists for it. Each chart is read with the dashboard's filters and the user's access to the connection, and a chart the report already reads that way is reused. Reading a dashboard can take a minute: past the wait the call answers that the source is still being read, so send the same call again, which reuses what the first one added. It runs one at a time with your queryReportData, previewReportDatasheetChanges and saveReportDatasheetChanges calls: send it once they answer. Only the report's editors may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

elements.description: The charts to add, only the ones the slides need, at most 12 a call.

as.description: `data` for its table, to read with `getReportDatasheetData` and draw as a chart, table or figure on a slide; `picture` for its image, to place on a slide as it looks; `both` for the two. Ask only for a read the element lists in its `reads`.

ref.description: A chart's `ref` from the `elements` `getReportDatasheet` lists for this dashboard. For a table Tableau builds from several worksheets side by side, the refs of those worksheets joined by commas, like `12,15,18`, add it as one.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

datasheetId.description: One of this report's datasheets, by its `id` in `listReportDatasheets`.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: addReportDashboardElements
title: Add dashboard charts to report
